title: Cloud drives
toggle.on: Mount at ~/Cloud/%1, also after every login
toggle.off: Unmount, and stop mounting at login
toggle.unusable: rclone@ cannot mount a remote named like this
drive.project: OAuth client of Google Cloud project %1. Keep its publishing status "In production": while it is "Testing", Google ends the login after 7 days.
drive.shared: Uses rclone's shared OAuth client, which is being retired during 2026. Switch to a client of your own.
guide.drive.client: 1. Get the client ID and secret of a "Desktop app" OAuth client from your Google Cloud project.
guide.drive.clientKnown: 1. Get the client ID and secret of the "Desktop app" OAuth client in project %1, the one your other Drive remote uses.
guide.drive.login: 2. Log in. A terminal asks for the ID and secret, then the browser opens Google's login.
guide.onedrive.login: 1. Log in with your Microsoft account. rclone connects that account's own OneDrive. A work account may need an admin to approve rclone first; for a SharePoint library use rclone config.
guide.mount: Afterwards, switch on the mount here.
